rules: Extract actual user string/text blocks before display placeholders, truncation or incomplete markers are inserted
Carry bounded preview provenance with the corresponding native observation; never infer it from normalized display text
Do not blacklist bracketed text or placeholder prefixes: a user may literally type identical text
Apply the same extraction boundary to live messages and correlated native history hydration
Missing, opaque or omitted input must not be reconstructed from hidden payloads or a cached display
